{{Quote|Tomorrow, Taasi wants to take me somewhere 'very important': the Temple of the Progenitor. A place so sacred for the Selkath... it is said that this is where their worship of the great Progenitor originated. I do not believe any outsider has ever set foot inside the temple. To be invited to see it is an honor and a privilege.|[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ayturr Odock]]|<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Temple of the Progenitor}}</ref>}}
The '''Temple of the Progenitor''' was a sacred temple in the [[Ancient Selkath City]],<ref name="TOR:ACP" /> in the [[Asutvu Rift]], deep beneath the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="TOR:RitR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Retribution in the Rift|Manaan}}</ref> The temple was named after the legendary<ref name="Codex" /> [[Firaxan shark/Legends|firaxan shark]]<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/KOTORCreaturesFiraxa|text=Creatures of KOTOR 1: Firaxa and Gizka}}</ref> known to the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] as the [[Progenitor]]. The temple was one of the most sacred sites in Selkath culture; it was believed to be the origin point of the Selkath's [[Deity/Legends|worship]] of the great firaxan [[Shark/Legends|shark]].<ref name="Codex" />

[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ayturr Odock]] was invited to visit the temple during her visit to Manaan. Odock believed that no outsider had ever set foot in the temple, and was honored by the invitation.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Temple of the Progenitor first appeared in the Manaan Daily Area introduced in Game Update 7.1: ''Digging Deeper'', released on [[August 2]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220802|text=Game Update 7.1 "Digging Deeper" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
